caption:
Stop replacing a mattress over one spill.

Spills, sweat, and dead skin soak into a mattress over years, and once that happens there is no real way to clean it out. Dust mites build up the same way, especially in a bed used every night.

This queen size protector zips completely around the mattress, so it's fully waterproof and keeps bed bugs and dust mites from getting in or out. It's rated 4.6 stars by over a hundred thousand shoppers.

Zip it on once and the mattress underneath stays protected instead of stained or worn out, for about $22.
